_about: The Minds layer's world: who can perceive what, where. Ids and text keys only. The hall's Mirror room id is still 'clearing'. Tuning lives here (limits, perception); everything a rule decides is written into the event log when it happens, so retuning never invalidates a save.

clocks._about: Convention clocks (TONE_MAPPING section 4). A cadence names how fast a custom goes quiet: sprint customs in Mirror ticks of days, bell customs of months. dormancy is ticks nobody feeds it before it fades; revivals is how many times it may come back, unexplained. GUESSES until DESIGN-FREEZE (X13 to X20).

PROP_POKED._about: A prop was pressed. Sight needs the room and a clear line; the thump carries into the next room, where it is only overheard.

PROP_ECHOED._about: A prop moved on its own, answering an earlier poke (world rule: the hall answers late).

WALKED._about: The witch crossed the floor. Quiet: written to the log only when somebody reacts to it.
